walkthroughs.body_html:
Nigeria is the regional powerhouse of West Africa.

Population over 220 million and oil-rich Niger Delta.

It is classed as a Newly Emerging Economy.

The economy is shifting.

Primary share is falling as manufacturing and services grow.

Cement giant Dangote and Nollywood show the new economy.

Shell is a key TNC.

It brings jobs, taxes and infrastructure but is blamed for oil spills in the Niger Delta.

This shows the trade-offs of TNC investment.

mcqs.q: Why do TNCs locate production in LICs?
options: Because LICs have better infrastructure than HICs.
Urban heat islands only happen in summer.
Lower labour costs, weaker regulation, access to raw materials, large potential markets, and government incentives like tax breaks in special economic zones.
Because TNCs want to develop poorer countries and lift them out of poverty.

mcqs.q: Why is the urban heat island effect strongest at night?
options: Urban heat islands only happen in summer.
Because LICs have better infrastructure than HICs.
Urban heat islands are strongest at midday because cities are sunniest then.
Concrete and brick released their stored daytime heat slowly into the night air, while rural areas cool rapidly through radiative loss — widening the urban-rural temperature gap after sunset.

Because LICs have better infrastructure than HICs.
A large-scale map shows a large area.
